div.div:
dēpressĭo , ōnis, f. deprimo,
I.a pressing or sinking down, a depression (not ante-Aug., and very rare), Macr. S. 1, 20: “fundamentorum ad solidum,” Vitr. 1, 3, 2 : Socratica nasi, i. e. flat nose (opp. curva erectio), Macr. S. 7, 3, § 11.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
